userStories.title: Investigate file upload JSON parsing bug
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to find the root cause of the JSON parsing error when uploading PDF/DOCX files.
acceptanceCriteria: Locate file upload API endpoint (likely /api/tools/parse-resume or similar)
Read the API route handler code
Identify where response.json() is called on non-JSON response
Identify server error causing 'Internal S...' response
Document root cause in notes field
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: ROOT CAUSE: Version mismatch in pdf-parse. Package: pdf-parse@2.4.5 (class-based API). Types: @types/pdf-parse@1.1.5 (function-based API). Code uses 'new PDFParse({data})' and 'parser.getText()' which fails at runtime. Server returns plain text error, client calls response.json() on it -> JSON parse error. API: /api/tools/extract-text. Files: route.ts (lines 123-131), resume-file-upload.tsx (lines 128-149).

userStories.title: Fix file upload API error handling
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to fix the server-side error that causes the JSON parsing failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Server endpoint returns proper JSON for all responses

PDF parsing errors are caught and return JSON error
DOCX parsing errors are caught and return JSON error
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added try-catch-finally to extractTextFromPdf with proper cleanup (parser.destroy()). Added try-catch to extractTextFromDocx for mammoth errors. All errors propagate to main handler which returns JSON {error}. Typecheck passes.

userStories.notes: Restructured extractText function: checks response.ok before JSON parse, graceful error parsing with fallback to statusText, network errors caught. Error clears on retry (setError(null) at start). Typecheck passes.
